decisions.reason: Cites LinkType Junction/Target and the link: marker; establishes one physical copy so repo edits already deploy and copying through the junction is a self-copy, distinguished from package-managed installs.

Host process owns the file handles and module/boot caches; closing the tab provably released nothing (retry after close still EBUSY); browser HTTP cache treated as a separate layer needing hard refresh after host restart; appropriately version-scoped rather than universal.

Explains the junction-addressed rename hit the only physical file, so the copy's source no longer existed; restores client.js.old2/index.js.old2 by rename preserving content, verifies with node --check plus content grep, stops host first.
Ordered procedure: edit repo, static check, full host stop, start, hard refresh, then byte-level and behavioral verification with load-error absence; browser-only restart explicitly insufficient.
Preflight reads LinkType/Target and the link: marker before touching files, gives an interpretation table for linked vs copied modes, and explains why generic copy advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly forbids copying into node_modules and renames .old2 back in place.
Plan requires full host stop/start; states a browser refresh or tab close is not a host stop.
